title: Normalize library profile override keys
summary: Canonicalized library profile IDs across the WebView editor and save-review path, blocked stale LibraryProfiles patches from riding along with unrelated settings saves, and added regression coverage for movie alias saves and new profile IDs.
reason: Changing a movie fallback override could surface a broad LibraryProfiles diff because profile aliases and stale profile patch state were not handled consistently in the WebView save path.
behavior_before: The settings review could present movie profile overrides under alias-shaped labels such as movie.editor.SizeGuardMode, and a stale LibraryProfiles patch could be previewed or saved while the operator was changing unrelated settings.
behavior_after: Movie, movies, show, shows, and tv profile IDs are canonicalized before editor state lookup and save-review comparison; new custom profiles keep stable generated IDs; stale LibraryProfiles patches are blocked before backend preview/save.
tests_added: tests.webview.test_webview_settings_libraries.WebViewSettingsLibrariesStaticTests.test_settings_libraries_asset_tracks_explicit_override_state static assertions for canonical IDs and stale LibraryProfiles blocking
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView canonicalization and stale-patch guard changes plus the related regression fixtures/tests and refreshed generated summaries; then re-run the targeted settings patch and WebView settings-library tests.
